verdict.rationale: The only user-defined rule-to-action behavior in the pack is Spend Management, which sends alerts or pauses projects when spend reaches a set amount. That is a narrow, billing-only trigger. Auto-snapshot on stop is fixed built-in behavior, not a rule the user defines. Missing for 10: general event-triggered rules or automations, webhooks or event subscriptions for sandbox lifecycle events, configurable triggers beyond spend thresholds, and independent corroboration.
